summary: Meta Platforms filed an 8-K (Items 8.01/9.01) disclosing completion, on November 5, 2026, of a $15.0 billion multi-tranche USD senior notes offering under its existing Form S-3 shelf: $3.25B 5.850% notes due 2031, $3.25B 6.250% due 2033, $4.0B 6.550% due 2036, $1.75B 7.350% due 2046 and $2.75B 7.500% due 2056. Citigroup and Morgan Stanley were underwriter representatives; U.S. Bank Trust is trustee under the supplemented indenture. This is a routine investment-grade debt capital raise, not a special situation; no equity terms, premium or deal clock apply.
